summary: Read an integer n, the count of courses, labeled with integers from 0 through n minus 1. Then read prerequisite pairs. In a pair, the first label is the course you want and the second label is the course you must finish earlier. For example, the pair 0 with 1 means course 0 waits until course 1 is done. Pairs arrive as a list of edges, not as a matrix, and no edge repeats. Judge whether every course can be finished. Write false when the prerequisites form a cycle, and write true otherwise. n may be 0.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
